sam_sales: quick heads-up — ACME asked about mixing reserved capacity credits with per-token billing. they want credits to cover base throughput and only charge overage above a threshold. can we do this without creating accounting headaches?

anya_pm: thanks. do we have the customer's committed qps and current monthly token usage? need to know if credits are per-token, per-concurrent, or dollar credits.

sam_sales: they're committing ~1M tokens/day (~30M/mo) on a 12mo commit. usage spikes to ~2M/day on peak days. sales expects a commit-level discount + auto-burst overage at a higher per-token rate. customer asked that credits apply first before any overage billing.

mike_support: fyi their integration is many small streaming requests. batching helps but doesn't fully smooth spikes. we see overages concentrated in last ~7 days of cycle when they run feature experiments.

liz_finance: flag: credits that roll over or convert to dollars complicate revenue recognition and forecasting. recommend: credits consumed first, unused credits expire at month end, overage billed at premium rate. also need explicit refund/no-refund language.

deepak_se: two packaging options to consider:
```
option_a:
  type: committed_token_pool
  commit: 30M/month
  consume_order: credits_first
  unused: expire_month_end
  overage_rate: 1.8x_hosted_rate

option_b:
  type: commit_plus_burst_buffer
  commit: reserved_slots + small_daily_burst
  burst_refresh: daily
  overage: applied_after_burst
```
option_a is simpler to bill and explain. option_b gives better tail performance but needs routing changes and extra metrics.

sam_sales: customer prefers option_a. proposed prices: committed_rate = $0.00075/token, overage = $0.0015/token, credits expire monthly. is that within product/finance guardrails?

anya_pm: we need product + finance signoff. product risks: console UX to show credit consumption, alerting for near-exhaustion, edge-case support churn. infra risks: per-customer consume-order logic and accurate metering at high write rates. action: i'll create an intake on the product board and tag billing + infra. mark as High — pricing decision needed for Q2 launch.

billing-bot: Created intake: https://redwood.office/boards/PRD-5421 — assignees: anya_pm, deepak_se. Priority: high

anya_pm: thanks :thumbsup: sam, please get written confirmation from the customer on commit size and acceptance of monthly expiry. mike, can you capture 3 potential failure modes for overage billing (double-charge, delayed metering, spike misattribution)? i'll schedule a 30m scoping sync tomorrow 9am PT.

sam_sales: on it, pinging legal and will share the note in this thread.
